function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the specified CSV file.

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file where the todo will be added.

todo.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

priority.description: Priority level for the todo item. Valid values: low, medium, high, critical.

status.description: Status of the todo item. Default is 'pending'.

created_at.description: Optional creation timestamp for the todo item in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
